title: Unbounded Quaternion Drift in IMU Sensor Fusion Node
symptom: Autonomous quadrotor pitch/roll estimate drifted exponentially after 4 minutes of flight.
root_cause: Complementary filter failed to re-normalize output quaternion, causing floating-point accumulation error in rotation matrix calculation.
mitigation: Added explicit L2 quaternion normalization step after every orientation integration tick.

title: STM32 I2C Bus Lockup Due to Missing Clock Pulsing on Slave Hang
symptom: SDA line pulled permanently LOW, locking HAL_I2C_Master_Transmit in busy state forever.
root_cause: I2C slave peripheral suffered power glitch during byte read, leaving SDA held low waiting for SCL clock pulses.
mitigation: Implemented software GPIO bit-banging bus recovery sequence (9 SCL clock pulses + STOP condition) on I2C initialization.

title: Ground Bounce Induced Microcontroller Reset During High-Current Motor Acceleration
symptom: MCU reset unexpectedly whenever BLDC motor accelerated rapidly from rest.
root_cause: Shared ground return trace between high-current H-bridge drivers and low-voltage MCU digital ground caused 1.2V ground voltage spike.
mitigation: Redesigned PCB layout with split star-grounding architecture and added 470uF low-ESR bulk electrolytic decoupling capacitors.

title: ROS2 Callback Executor Queue Saturation Under High-Frequency PointCloud2 Publishing
symptom: Subscriber node experienced 800ms message latency and high RAM allocation growth.
root_cause: Single-threaded ROS2 executor used default depth=100 queue with heavy PointCloud processing in callback thread.
mitigation: Switched node to MultiThreadedExecutor, set QoS depth=1 with volatile durability, and offloaded pointcloud filtering to worker thread.

title: Robotic Arm Joint Backlash Accumulation Under Reversing Load Torque
symptom: End-effector position error exceeded +/- 4mm during motion trajectory reversals.
root_cause: Spur gear reducer tooth wear combined with loose motor coupling set-screw backlash.
mitigation: Upgraded joint reduction to zero-backlash harmonic drive and mounted secondary absolute encoder on output shaft.

title: Uncaught Memory Allocation Failure in Long-Running Serial Parser
symptom: System crashed with hard fault after 12 hours of continuous serial telemetry stream.
root_cause: Dynamic buffer allocation (`new uint8_t[len]`) inside packet handler without deallocation on malformed checksum packets.
mitigation: Eliminated dynamic allocation entirely; replaced with static ring buffer architecture.

title: Aliasing Distortion in Digital Low-Pass Filter due to Nyquist Rate Violation
symptom: Spurious low-frequency oscillations appeared in accelerometer signal during high-vibration engine operation.
root_cause: ADC sampled at 100Hz without hardware analog anti-aliasing filter while mechanical vibration frequency was at 180Hz.
mitigation: Added 2nd-order analog RC low-pass filter (fc=40Hz) prior to ADC input pins and increased ADC sampling rate to 1kHz.

title: Ariane 5 Flight 501 64-bit to 16-bit Floating-Point Conversion Overflow
symptom: Rocket veered off flight path at 37 seconds post-launch, aerodynamic loads caused vehicle breakup and self-destruction.
root_cause: Reuse of Ariane 4 software where horizontal bias variable exceeded 16-bit signed integer limits (+32,767); uncaught operand error halted both active and backup computers.
mitigation: Mandate explicit software range validation across all trajectory parameters and eliminate unhandled hardware trap resets during flight.

title: Mars Climate Orbiter Trajectory Disintegration from Metric-Imperial Unit Mismatch
symptom: Spacecraft entered Martian atmosphere at 57 km altitude instead of expected 226 km and disintegrated.
root_cause: Ground software emitted thruster impulse commands in pound-force seconds (lbf·s) while spacecraft flight navigation expected metric newton-seconds (N·s).
mitigation: Enforce static type checking with dimensionally-typed units (e.g. C++ std::chrono / Boost.Units) and end-to-end interface contracts.

title: Therac-25 Radiation Therapy Massive Overdose from Race Condition
symptom: Patients received massive radiation doses (>100x target) causing severe radiation burns and fatalities.
root_cause: Concurrent operator keystroke editing bypassed software safety interlock flag while physical tungsten beam collimator was still moving.
mitigation: Require independent hardware interlocks for safety-critical actuators; formal mathematical verification for concurrent state transitions.

title: MIM-104 Patriot Missile Clock Drift Battery Intercept Failure at Dhahran
symptom: Patriot missile battery failed to track and intercept incoming Scud missile, resulting in 28 casualties.
root_cause: 24-bit fixed-point register truncated internal system clock by 0.000000095 seconds per tick; after 100 hours of continuous operation, accumulated time shift was 0.34 seconds (687 meters range error).
mitigation: Use high-precision double-precision floating point or 64-bit integer tick counters with periodic clock synchronization.

title: Boeing 737 MAX Maneuvering Characteristics Augmentation System (MCAS) Single-Sensor Reliance
symptom: Repeated uncommanded nose-down stabilizer trim activations overcoming pilot control column inputs.
root_cause: MCAS flight control law relied on a single Angle-of-Attack (AoA) vane without sensor cross-comparison or disagree alert interlock.
mitigation: Enforce multi-sensor tri-modular redundancy (TMR), cross-channel voting, and restrict authority limits of automatic flight control surfaces.
